description: Inforiver Writeback Matrix is the most comprehensive no-code writeback and planning solution for Power BI. It supports data write back to on-premise & cloud destinations including SQLServer, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse/ Warehouse, Dataverse, Snowflake, Databricks, RedShift, BigQuery, OneDrive, SharePoint, and webhook REST API endpoint URL destinations. KEY FEATURES The Inforiver Writeback Matrix delivers all features supported by Inforiver Reporting Matrix, and more: Advanced data input field types - including numeric, text, single/multi select dropdowns, check box, person and date fields Write back/ save data in SQL and Parquet formats; write back from reading view; write back specific rows & columns; write back with context set by external slicers; use webhooks to trigger Power Automate workflows, Azure functions, HTTP / XMLA endpoints Create secure comments and conversations; tag users; trigger notifications; schedule comment digests; Create static snapshots after period close or at custom frequencies; compare variances; Create and compare planning scenarios; write back scenarios Self-service scheduling and bursting of reports; schedule at custom frequencies; schedule to multiple users based on report tabs, custom filters, etc., schedule PDF/Excel reports to external stakeholders Enhance writeback scalability and performance through filter context support and…
